title: ResearchTask.v1
description: A single bounded research assignment commissioned FROM a needs_action ContextTriageResult. It tells a bounded open-ended agent (research.local_stub, or a candidate provider) WHAT to find — the fact_key, the question, the authority bar it must meet, and the BOUNDS it must stay inside (max steps, allowed access, offline/no-secrets). The agent DISCOVERS and PROPOSES; this task can never instruct the agent to serve or promote a fact. produces is pinned to source_discovery_report — research output is candidate sources, never truth. Deterministic when created_at is injected.

task_id.description: content-addressed over (triage_id, fact_key, question); version in metadata, never in the id

triage_id.description: the ContextTriageResult that warranted this research (lineage back-link)

question.description: the precise question the agent must answer with discovered SOURCES (not its own knowledge)

authority_bar.description: the minimum authority the discovered source(s) must meet to be acceptable

bounds.description: the hard bounds the bounded agent runs inside — the agent may not exceed these

max_steps.description: step budget; an agent past budget aborts and reports partial

allowed_access.description: the ONLY access methods this research may use (allowlisted; default fixture-only in the lean core)

offline.description: true in the lean core — research.local_stub is deterministic and never calls out

secrets_allowed.description: pinned false — a research task never carries or grants secrets

assigned_provider.description: the research_agent_provider adapter id (e.g. research.local_stub@v1); candidate providers are catalog stubs that do not call out

produces.description: pinned — research produces a SourceDiscoveryReport (candidate sources), NEVER a fact / canonical truth

agent_may_serve_truth.description: pinned false — the invariant: agents discover and propose, they never serve or promote truth
